walkthroughs.title: Read the why
walkthroughs.description: AI writes the code. Its comments explain the why. Four steps, about a minute.

steps.title: Open a file your AI wrote
steps.description:
Any code file works, as long as it has comments in it.
[Open a sample file](command:vibeRead.openSample)

steps.title: Press Alt+X
steps.description: The code disappears, the reasoning stays. Press it again to bring it back.

media.altText: The same function with the code hidden

steps.title: Select a few lines, press Alt+X again
steps.description: Sometimes you want one piece of code back. Select it, press Alt+X.

steps.title: Press Alt+M
steps.description: Keeps it as notes — the reasoning as text, the code folded under it.

vibeRead.mark.markdownDescription:
Your vibe — what you see wherever the code is hidden, and the one shown in the status bar. An ellipsis by default, on purpose: an emoji repeated down a whole page is the noise this extension exists to remove.

Easier to change from the status bar than from here.

vibeRead.marks.markdownDescription:
The slots offered when you click your vibe in the status bar. Their names — Mute, Shh, Hide, Vibe, Code, Yours — belong to the slots, so putting something else in the Shh slot still leaves it your Shh.

Easier to change there than here: the pencil on each row opens your system's emoji keyboard. Delete this setting to get these back.

vibeRead.showEditorButton.description: Show the Vibe Read buttons above the editor while the code is hidden.
